resources.string: Runs the phone in a power-saving mode: a dark home screen with six apps, background limits while the screen is off, and every change put back when you switch it off.
Tap to grant root in ResukiSU, then Allow
No root. Open ResukiSU → Superuser → allow Super Power Saving.
Your six apps stay available while the mode is on. Everything else can be paused.
Hold an app to change it
Everything the mode changed will be put back the way it was, including your home screen and any apps it paused.
Turn on super power saving mode?

A copy of every change is written down first, so Exit can put it all back.

• The six apps you chose keep working
• Calls and SMS keep working
• Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, NFC and location are touched only if you left those options on
• The phone sleeps deeply as soon as the screen goes off
• The power button still wakes it instantly
Tip: add the Super Power Save tile in Quick Settings.
Saving a copy, then switching on…

Check what works on this phone
Checking every option. This takes about five minutes — leave the phone alone until it finishes.

Each option is applied, tested on the phone and put back, one after another. This takes about five minutes, and you can leave the phone aside while it runs — the mode is switched off for the check and stays off afterwards.\n\nWhat works on this phone is saved to /data/adb/spsm/state/probe.tsv and shown under each option.
